exposure: Hydromorphone 0.05 mg/mL + Nalbuphine 0.5 mg/mL (group LN) for PCA
Hydromorphone 0.05 mg/mL + Nalbuphine 0.7 mg/mL (group MN) for PCA
Hydromorphone 0.05 mg/mL + Nalbuphine 0.9 mg/mL (group HN) for PCA
outcome: Visual analog scale (VAS) for pain (incisional, uterine cramping at rest, uterine cramping after breast-feeding, pain with oxytocin infusion)
cohort: Healthy parturients undergoing elective cesarean section.
finding: Hydromorphone 0.05 mg/mL + nalbuphine 0.7 mg/mL for intravenous patient-controlled analgesia effectively improved incisional pain, uterine cramping pain management, and comfort in patients after cesarean section.
